column3: Writing and prohibition are combined as the written decree.
The kneeling on knees is expressed as getting down on knees.
“Exiles” renders sons of exile; “still” is supplied.
“Rings” renders the collective singular signet of his nobles.
“Falsely accused” renders ate his pieces; children renders sons.
People of every nation and language combines peoples, nations, and languages; prosperity renders peace.
“Will never end” renders until the end.
